%ABS.text: The absolute value of a number: `%ABS(&DIFF)`. An `*INT` stays `*INT`, a `*DEC` stays `*DEC`.

%CHAR.text: A number as text, with no padding: `%CHAR(&COUNT)` gives `42`, a `*DEC` keeps its decimals (`12.50`). This is the only way to put a number into a `*CHAR` or join it to text.

%DEC.text: A value as a `*DEC`: `%DEC(&TEXT)`, or `%DEC(&X 7 2)` for 7 digits with 2 decimals (half-up). With no length it is `LEN(15 5)`; a length alone has no decimals. Text that isn't a number is {{msg ELC0003}}; too many digits {{msg ELC0007}}.

%ELEM.text: Element *n* of a `*LIST`, counting from 1: `%ELEM(&DEVS 3)`. Outside 1 to the list's size is {{msg ELC0006}}.

%INT.text: A value as an `*INT`, decimals dropped (towards zero): `%INT('500')`, `%INT(&PCT)`. Text that isn't a number is {{msg ELC0003}}.

%LEN.text: The length of a string without its trailing blanks: a `*CHAR LEN(32)` holding `IRON` gives 4.

%NAME.text: The display name of an item ID (`%NAME('LOGIC_DIE')` gives `Logic Die`), or the ID itself when there's no such item. Worked out on the server: see [the limits](page:elcl/status-and-limits#known-limits).

%SCAN.text: Where one string first appears in another, counting from 1, or 0 if it doesn't: `%SCAN('ORE' &ITEM)`. A third argument starts the search there: `%SCAN(' ' &DATA 7)`. The search string's trailing blanks are ignored.

%SIZE.text: The number of elements in a `*LIST` (0 for an empty one).

%SST.text: A substring: `%SST(&S start length)`, counting from 1. `%SST(&DATA 1 5)` is the first five characters. Past the end of the string is {{msg ELC0004}}.

%TRIM.text: The string with leading and trailing blanks removed.

%TRIML.text: The string with leading blanks removed.

%TRIMR.text: The string with trailing blanks removed.
